FullName.description: <namespace>/<name>: the namespace is a GitHub login in lower case, at most 39 characters; the name is what Mojo code imports.

schema.description: 2: a package in a namespace, whose name and dependency names are full names; mopm reads only 2. 1: a package of the flat names a registry still serves to older clients.

version.description: The package version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. When present it must equal the version being published.

source_sha256.description: The sha256 of the package's sources, as lowercase hex: of the text made of one line '<sha256 of the file> <path>' and a newline per file, sorted by the bytes of the path, with paths relative to the package directory and '/' as the separator. The files are the package's mopm.toml, every regular file below its library directory ([targets] lib, src/<import name> by default; a symlink is read through) and the source of each program of [targets] bins. mopm pack, publish and stage write it whenever the library directory exists. Two builds of one version for different Mojo compilers carry the same value: the registry takes a build for another compiler into a published version only when it does, and a version without the key can get none.

range.description: The requirement from mopm.toml, cargo syntax, copied verbatim (spec/mopm-toml.md, Version requirements).

path.description: A local path, for co-development. A dependency with a path must also have a range: publish refuses a path without a version.

file.description: Shared object, relative to this file. Required for kind shared and both.

static_file.description: Static archive, relative to this file. Required for kind static and both.

needs.description: Sonames of native libraries from other packages this one needs.

exclusive.description: An exclusivity group: a closure links at most one native library of a group. Names are compared exactly: no leading or trailing space, no control character.
